dedupe_keys.name: 2026 bes lca tea coupled techno economic and climate bound for commodity production in wastewater bioelectrochemical systems model and data v1 0 2

description: Mingming Chen, Helia Khatami and Daqian Jiang publish a Python package for techno-economic and climate accounting of wastewater bioelectrochemical product recovery. Zenodo archives version 1.0.2 under MIT for code; the description separately assigns CC BY 4.0 to configuration, inputs and result tables. Its model couples an idealised bioelectrochemical cell with stack cost, downstream processing and cradle-to-gate climate balance across thirteen commodity products. A command regenerates CSV tables and regression checks from YAML configuration. This model can compare wastewater-treatment or resource-recovery process scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this tool. Coverage is the specified technology and commodity assumptions, not observed commercial plant operation. A limitation is that an ideal zero-gap cell, complete Coulombic efficiency and aggregated third-party factors bound the result; no ecoinvent dataset is redistributed. The archive was not downloaded, the command was not run and cost or emissions claims were not independently verified.
